mechanism_claims.claim_text: Brevinin-2GUb, tB2U-K, and tB2U-6K showed source-reported S. aureus membrane permeabilization in the SYTOX Green assay at MIC or 2x MIC; tB2U-K also had reported permeability at lower tested concentrations.
